For the Petitioners : Mr. Mahavir Prasad Sinha, Advocate : Mr. Santosh Kr Jha, Advocate For the State : Ms. Amrita Kumari, A.P.P. : Ms. Nehala Sharmin, A.P.P. -----
06/14.06.2024 Both these Anticipatory Bail applications arise out of the same police case.
Accordingly, they are being disposed of by a common order.

Heard the parties Petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Mango P.S. Case No.
13 of 2018 corresponding to G.R. No. 174 of 2018, for the offences registered under Sections 376 (2)
(i) and 376 (D) of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 4 of the POCSO Act, pending in the Court of Special POCSO Judge-cum-ADJ-V at Singhbhum, Jamshedpur.
It is alleged that the daughter of the informant was employed by one Nanak Chand Seth.
It is further alleged that she established relationship with an electrician who was neighbor of Nanak Chand Seth.

It is alleged that several accused persons had raped her and the present F.I.R. was registered against three persons namely Shiv Kumar Mahto, Indrapal Saini and gardener of Sahara City namely Srikant.
Subsequenlty, the prosecutrix implicated 22 more persons including the present petitioners.
As far as the allegation against the present petitioners and 20 other persons are concerned, it was investigated by C.I.D., Jharkhand.
After investigation, C.I.D. Jharkhand submitted Imdad Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...

1 final form in this case which was accepted by the committing court.

During the course of trial,
prosecutrix again reiterated the name of 20 persons including the petitioners about their involvement in the present occurrence.

It is alleged that accused Tanusri Sardar @ Tanushree Nayak used to inject her making unconscious and the accused persons raped her; against petitioner Imad Ansari, it is alleged that he has also raped her.
The named accused persons have confessed their guilt and they have been convicted.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that named accused persons have also been granted bail at the appellate stage.
However, the State has challenged and moved before the Hon'ble Supreme Court for cancellation of their bail.

It was further submitted that similarly situated co- accused Ajay Kerketta @ Ajay Karketta has been granted Anticipatory Bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide A.B.A. No. 566 of 2024, Brij Mohan Gupta @ Guddu Gupta has been granted Anticipatory Bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide A.B.A. No. 774 of 2024, Amit Kumar Singh, Manoj Sahay and Gurpreet Singh have been granted Anticipatory Bail by the Coordinate Bench of this Court vide A.B.A. No. 2380 of 2024 and Dinesh Agarwal has been granted Anticipatory Bail by a Coordinate Bench of this Court vide A.B.A. No. 2381 of 2024.

Learned counsels appearing on behalf of the State have vehemently opposed the prayed for anticipatory bail and submitted that regular bail applications of co-accused Indrapal Singh Saini @
Nitu @ Indrapal Saini and Shiv Kumar Mahto and Others were rejected by another Coordinate Bench of this Court.
As far as accused persons whose regular bails have been rejected are concerned, they were named in the F.I.R.

As far as these petitioners are concerned, they are not named in the F.I.R. but their names were subsequently introduced and the Criminal Investigation Department after inquiry found the allegation false.
Accordingly, the final form was submitted.
The learned Magistrate, before whom the case was pending, had accepted the final form and the present petitioners had been arraigned under Section 319 of Cr.P.C.
It appears that other similarly situated co-accused persons have been granted Anticipatory Bail by the Coordinate Bench of this Court.
Considering the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly, the petitioners, above named, are directed to surrender before the learned court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and the learned court below on their surrender, shall release them on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/-
(Rupees Twenty five Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Special POCSO Judge-Cum-ADJ-V at Singhbhum, Jamshedpur in connection with Mango P.S. Case No. 13 of 2018 corresponding to G.R. No. 174 of 2018, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) Nandini/-
